# QnALog 1.4.0

QnALog now retains transcript source revisions and links session knowledge to the transcript passages it came from.

## Changes

- Save original recognition text separately from normalized display text, with stable transcript-unit IDs and available audio timing references.
- Add transcript references to extracted topics, decisions, actions, and questions within existing organization requests. This does not add a separate model request.
- Mark saved knowledge as stale when its transcript source changes, instead of presenting it as current.
- Store compact knowledge references in note-index v2 while keeping transcript text in the source record.
- Fix clean-copy generation so it creates or updates the separate Markdown note without first writing a redundant hidden snapshot. Obsidian's built-in Version History retains revisions of that note.

## User impact

- Newly created notes and notes actively processed by QnALog can contain hidden QnALog transcript and knowledge metadata. The visible transcript and existing reading layout remain unchanged.
- Existing notes are not rewritten in bulk. Note-index v1 remains readable and is converted when the index is refreshed.
- No settings schema, API key storage, service configuration, or device-selection change is included.
